cases.scope: Build and explicitly deliver a useful lightweight source BIM and viewer from the original textured mesh and supplied auxiliary evidence. Choose observations, precision, templates, worker delegation and local revisions autonomously. Prioritize overall massing, storey/terrace relationships and exterior opening positions, sizes and hosts. Interpret auxiliary drawings, relationship sketches and text locally according to their evidence: sketch proportions are not measurements. Keep user-confirmed facts, user conjectures and your inferences distinct. Organize unknown interiors plausibly at the requested simplification; no fixed room count, one-window-per-room rule or universal door offset. Use actual saved geometry and visible-host overlays to check; an overlay is not independent fidelity approval. Record assumptions and unresolved evidence, then finish_bim. Workers are optional read-only observers using the same configured model and shared run budget. The coordinator owns all BIM changes. The 5-10 minute target is not a quality cutoff.
